# Quantum Reference Coupon Collection

> Exact support recovery from quantum signal and reference copies under common unknown per-label phases.

The state copies are specified in the source model. For fixed missing-set size and linear budgets, the exact limiting minimax success depends on the harmonic combination of the two copy rates. A small paired receiver gives the linear copy scaling, and larger symmetry blocks approach the finite occupancy converse in a different regime. Independent phase mismatch changes these guarantees.
